name: Spark Eaters (CR 22)
body:
SPARK EATERS
CR 22

XP 614,400
N Large outsider
Init +15; Senses darkvision 60 ft.; Perception +30

DEFENSE

AC 40, touch 19, flat-footed 13 (+15 Dex, +4 natural armor,-1 size, +12 deflection (while incorporeal only))
hp 380 (23d10 +26)
Fort +16, Ref +30, Will + 28
Defensive Abilities Incorporeal; DR 15/legendary

OFFENSE

Speed 40 ft., fly 60ft. (perfect)
Melee 2 claws +38 (1d6+15 plus grab), bite +39 (1d8+15 plus slowing bite and grab)
Space 10 ft.;Reach 5 ft.
Special Attacks breath of stagnation, devour spark
Spell-Like Abilities (CL 20th)

At will-planeshift, teleport

STATISTICS

Str 40, Dex 40, Con 30, Int 20, Wis 37, Cha 34
Base Atk +23; CMB 39 (43 to grappling); CMD 54
Feats Ability Focus (devour spark), Body Shield, Combat Expertise, Combat Reflexes, Dodge, Felling Escape, Flyby Attack, Improved Grapple, Improved Trip, Multiattack, Toughness, Weapon Finesse, Weapon Focus (bite)
Skills Acrobatics +38, Bluff +38, Escape Artist +26, Fly +38, Knowledge (Religion) +28 Knowledge (Planes) +31, Perception +39, Sense Motive +36, Stealth +41, Swim +38, Use Magic Device +35

SPECIAL ABILITIES

Cone of Stagnation (Su)

As a standard action, a spark eater may release a 30 foot cone of stagnation from its mouth that slows all creatures as per the slow spell. A DC 35 Reflex save negates this effect.

Devour Spark (Su)

As a standard action, a spark eater may attempt to drain the very potential from a grappled creature. The grappled creature must make a DC 39 Will save or take 1d6 points of Charisma damage. Each time a creature fails this Will save, their divinity score is treated as being one lower than it otherwise would be for the purposes of all spells, class features, and other effects related to divinity score. This effect persists until all Charisma damage from this attack is healed. A creature with an effective divine spark of 0 affected by this ability must make a DC 39 Fortitude save or become exhausted. When a spark eater successfully lowers a creature’s divinity score with this attack, it gains temporary hp equal to the Charisma damage it dealt times 25 and becomes hasted for the next 3 rounds.

Slowing Bite (Su)

A spark eater’s bite attack can steal the potency and greatness from a creature. Creatures hit by a spark eater’s bite attack must make a DC 39 Fortitude save or become slowed as per the slow spell.

Solidify (Su)

As a swift action, a spark eater may cease to be incorporeal. Becoming incorporeal again is a free action.

ECOLOGY

Environment any
Organization solitary, pack (3-5 spark eaters)
Treasure standard
